_provenance: Best mean spellF1 (0.764 all, 0.754 DFL; official baseline 0.291 / 0.267 on the earlier simulator) of the 3-member GRU ensemble below, features v3, simulator v2 (Metrica's dead-time ball filled, tracker ball noise, 4% dropout -- harder and closer to the real ATD than v1, so not comparable with v1's 0.794 / 0.770), under 5-fold simulated-ATD cross-validation on 10 open matches (python -m tempolens.experiments --model ensemble). The change-head bonus helps for the first time.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py). Off: on the real match the tags agree with a confident model 83% (attacking codes) and 94% (defensive codes) of the time, yet the prior lowered the public-window spellF1 (0.43 vs 0.59, single GRU).
